news.headline: STAT News Asks Why Abivax, Long Seen as a Sure-Thing Takeover, Still Hasn't Been Acquired
news.summary: STAT examined why Abivax remains independent nine months into a year in which a roughly $20bn takeout was widely seen as likely to happen any day, noting the lack of visibility into any actual sale process and the flippant explanation that 'the French don't work in August.' The piece frames the stalled deal chatter against a backdrop of otherwise active 2026 biotech M&A.

news.headline: Abivax Named Among Three Top Immunology Takeover Targets in PharmaVoice Dealmaking Analysis
news.summary: PharmaVoice profiled Abivax alongside Spyre Therapeutics and MoonLake Immunotherapeutics as one of the immunology sector's most talked-about M&A candidates, citing the strong ABTECT maintenance data and a roughly $25bn addressable IBD market by 2030. It notes CEO Marc de Garidel dismissed earlier 2026 Eli Lilly acquisition rumors as 'noise,' and that the $920m July offering funds the company into 2029, reducing the urgency for a near-term sale.

news.headline: ABTECT Maintenance Part 2 Review: Obefazimod Sustains Week-44 Remission With No Dose-Dependent Malignancy Signal
news.summary: A detailed clinical review of the Phase 3 ABTECT Part 2 maintenance package confirmed that 37.2% of induction non-responders reached clinical remission and 34.5% endoscopic remission at Week 44 on continued 50 mg obefazimod, and that dose escalation to 50 mg recaptured clinical remission in 45.5% of patients who had relapsed in Part 1. Crucially, the expanded exposure showed malignancy and non-melanoma skin cancer rates consistent with UC background rates and no apparent dose-dependent signal.

news.headline: TCG Crossover and Invus Both Disclose 6-7% Stakes in Abivax Following the July Offering
news.summary: Healthcare crossover investor TCG Crossover (via managing partner Chen Yu) disclosed 6,007,834 ADSs, or 7.0% of Abivax, while long-standing holder Invus reported 4,825,759 shares, or 6.0%, both as of the post-offering share count. The filings show two dedicated biotech specialists held on through the large July equity raise rather than selling into strength, rounding out a stable, concentrated institutional register ahead of the NDA filing.

news.headline: Abivax Announces Positive Pre-NDA Interaction with the FDA for Obefazimod
news.summary: The FDA gave constructive feedback and aligned with Abivax on the planned submission strategy, content and format of the obefazimod NDA in moderately-to-severely active ulcerative colitis. Abivax confirmed it remains on track to file its first-ever NDA by the end of 2026, removing a key procedural uncertainty.

news.headline: Abivax Re-Engages Investment Bank Centerview for Big Pharma Takeover Talks, La Lettre Reports
news.summary: French outlet La Lettre reported that Abivax, having paused M&A discussions with suitors including AstraZeneca and Eli Lilly in late June to prioritize closing its $920m capital raise, immediately re-engaged Centerview Partners once the financing closed to reopen takeover talks. Both pharma majors are said to remain interested in obefazimod dating back to mid-2025's first positive Phase 3 data.

catalysts.label: Euronext Paris CAC family quarterly review - possible CAC 40 promotion
catalysts.detail: Abivax has already been promoted twice by Euronext in 2026: into the CAC Mid 60/SBF 120 at the September 2025 annual review, then into the larger CAC Next 20 and CAC Large 60 at the June 2026 quarterly review. Euronext's CAC Steering Committee meets and announces results on Thursday, September 10, 2026 - now under a week away - with changes effective after close on the third Friday of the month. With a market capitalisation still in the high single-digit to low double-digit EUR billions, a further step up into the flagship CAC 40 itself remains plausible but is not confirmed, and would force additional passive/index-tracker buying.

catalysts.label: H1 2026 financial results
catalysts.detail: Abivax has this date fixed in its published financial calendar, now roughly two and a half weeks out. The report will show the first full post-raise balance sheet (cash was EUR 491.6m at March 31, 2026 before the $920m July offering, with runway now guided into 2029) and the step-up in R&D and pre-launch commercial spend. Recent French financial press speculation (via La Lettre and market forums) has floated the possibility of the results date coinciding with an M&A or partnership announcement, though this is unconfirmed. Expect a business update on NDA preparation and the U.S. commercial build-out alongside the numbers regardless.

catalysts.label: Full ABTECT maintenance dataset at a major gastroenterology congress
catalysts.detail: Abivax presented its ABTECT induction late-breaker at UEG Week in October 2025 and has a consistent pattern of taking full datasets to autumn congresses. A detailed public presentation of the Week-44 maintenance efficacy and, above all, the complete malignancy/safety database would be the cleanest way to fully retire the June cancer-signal overhang. Neither a venue nor an abstract acceptance for a 2026 autumn congress has been announced yet.

catalysts.label: NDA submission to FDA for obefazimod in ulcerative colitis
catalysts.detail: After positive Phase 3 ABTECT induction data, the 44-week maintenance readout, the Part 2 refractory-patient dataset and the constructive pre-NDA meeting on July 30, 2026, Abivax plans to submit its first NDA for obefazimod in moderately-to-severely active UC in late Q4 2026. This is the single biggest near-term de-risking event and the gate that starts the FDA review clock. Management has reiterated the timeline at every update this year.

catalysts.label: MAA submission to the EMA for obefazimod in ulcerative colitis
catalysts.detail: Abivax guided to filing a Marketing Authorization Application in Europe in the second half of 2026, contingent on the (now positive) 44-week maintenance data. Recent communication has emphasised the Q4 2026 FDA filing without restating a precise EMA date, so exact MAA timing remains unconfirmed and could slip into H1 2027.

catalysts.label: Phase 2b ENHANCE-CD Crohn's disease 12-week induction topline data
catalysts.detail: Topline results from the Phase 2b induction trial of obefazimod in moderately-to-severely active Crohn's disease are guided for mid-2027 (enrollment started Q3 2024). A positive readout opens a second large indication for the miR-124 mechanism and is the main pipeline diversification event, but it likely lands near or just after the March-2027 option expiry.

catalysts.label: Potential FDA approval decision and U.S. launch of obefazimod
catalysts.detail: With a Q4 2026 filing and a standard review cycle, an FDA decision would fall roughly 10-12 months later, i.e. in H2 2027 - after the March-2027 call expiry. No PDUFA date exists yet because the NDA has not been submitted. The commercial organisation being hired since July is being built against this window, making it the ultimate approval and revenue catalyst for the equity.

pulse: Abivax shares have pulled back into the $110-$116 range in early September, off the six-month highs seen in late August, as a STAT News piece on September 3 crystallized investor frustration that a widely-expected ~$20bn takeover still hasn't materialized despite persistent AstraZeneca/Eli Lilly speculation and a reported Centerview re-engagement in July. Fundamentally the story remains de-risked and now about execution: the ABTECT maintenance safety database continues to show malignancy rates in line with UC background rates, institutional holders (TCG Crossover, Invus) held through the July raise, FDA alignment on the NDA is locked in for a late-Q4 2026 filing, and the $920m July raise funds a solo U.S. launch into 2029 with a senior commercial team already hired. For the March-2027 $120 call the position remains roughly at or modestly in the money at current levels, with two dated catalysts now imminent - Euronext's September 10 CAC index review (possible CAC 40 promotion) and the September 21 H1 report, which some traders speculate could be timed alongside an M&A or partnership announcement, though that remains unconfirmed chatter rather than company guidance.
